import argparse
import os
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Coerce types used downstream
    df['Released_Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce').astype(int)
    df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['Meta_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Meta_score'], errors='coerce')
    df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce').astype(int)

    # ASSERTION_START
    # Uniqueness of (Series_Title, Released_Year)
    assert not df.duplicated(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).any()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Slug and canonical URL depend on uniqueness of (title, year)
    title_norm = (
        df['Series_Title']
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .str.strip()
        .str.replace(r"[^a-z0-9\s\-]+", "", regex=True)
        .str.replace(r"\s+", "-", regex=True)
        .str.replace(r"-+", "-", regex=True)
        .str.strip('-')
    )
    df['slug'] = title_norm + '-' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str)
    df['canonical_url'] = 'https://www.streamco.example/movies/' + df['slug']

    # Guard year-dependent freshness computation
    # ASSERTION_START
    # Year boundaries and distributional constraint
    year_between_bounds = (df['Released_Year'] >= 1900) & (df['Released_Year'] <= 2024)
    assert year_between_bounds.all()
    pct_1930_2020 = ((df['Released_Year'] >= 1930) & (df['Released_Year'] <= 2020)).mean()
    assert pct_1930_2020 >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Freshness score (scaled sigmoid anchored around 2005)
    df['freshness_score'] = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-(df['Released_Year'] - 2005) / 10.0))

    # Poster link validation occurs before use in SEO objects
    # ASSERTION_START
    def is_valid_https(u: str) -> bool:
        try:
            p = urlparse(str(u))
            return (p.scheme == 'https') and bool(p.netloc) and ('.' in p.netloc)
        except Exception:
            return False
    assert df['Poster_Link'].map(is_valid_https).all()
    uniq_ratio = df['Poster_Link'].nunique(dropna=False) / len(df)
    assert uniq_ratio >= 0.98
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Functional dependency: for each (Series_Title, Released_Year) there is exactly one Poster_Link
    # ASSERTION_START
    pl_counts = df.groupby(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year'])['Poster_Link'].nunique(dropna=False)
    assert (pl_counts == 1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Runtime parsing depends on strict pattern
    # ASSERTION_START
    runtime_series = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
    assert runtime_series.str.fullmatch(r'^[0-9]{2,3} min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    runtime_extract = runtime_series.str.extract(r'^([0-9]{2,3}) min$')[0].astype(int)
    df['Runtime_Minutes'] = runtime_extract

    # Ranged runtime constraints used by runtime alignment
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['Runtime_Minutes'] >= 45) & (df['Runtime_Minutes'] <= 240)).all()
    pct_runtime_mid = ((df['Runtime_Minutes'] >= 80) & (df['Runtime_Minutes'] <= 180)).mean()
    assert pct_runtime_mid >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # IMDB rating bounds and distribution used in ranking
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 0.0) & (df['IMDB_Rating'] <= 10.0)).all()
    assert (df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Meta score sanity before correlation and weighting
    # ASSERTION_START
    non_null_meta = df['Meta_score'].notna()
    assert ((df.loc[non_null_meta, 'Meta_score'] >= 0) & (df.loc[non_null_meta, 'Meta_score'] <= 100)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Interplay of Meta_score and IMDB_Rating
    # ASSERTION_START
    meta_imdb = df[df['Meta_score'].notna()][['Meta_score', 'IMDB_Rating']]
    if len(meta_imdb) > 1:
        corr_val = meta_imdb['Meta_score'].corr(meta_imdb['IMDB_Rating'])
        assert corr_val > 0.4
    hi_meta = df[df['Meta_score'].notna() & (df['Meta_score'] >= 90)]
    if len(hi_meta) > 0:
        assert (hi_meta['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.5).mean() >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Certificate x Genre rules used to generate family-friendly flags
    # ASSERTION_START
    genre_str = df['Genre'].fillna('').astype(str)
    cert_str = df['Certificate'].fillna('').astype(str)
    horror_mask = genre_str.str.contains('Horror', case=False, regex=False)
    assert (~(horror_mask & cert_str.isin({'U', 'G'}))).all()
    anim_family_mask = genre_str.str.contains('Animation', case=False, regex=False) | genre_str.str.contains('Family', case=False, regex=False)
    assert (~(anim_family_mask & (cert_str == 'A'))).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Gross constraints before parsing and monetization features
    # ASSERTION_START
    gross_non_null = df['Gross'].notna()
    assert gross_non_null.mean() >= 0.80
    gross_str = df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross'].astype(str).str.strip()
    assert gross_str.str.fullmatch(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['Gross_USD'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross_USD'] = (
        df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross']
          .astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
          .astype(int)
    )

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross_USD'] > 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Votes constraints before log transform
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['No_of_Votes'] > 0).all()
    assert (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 10000).mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Director vs cast constraints before talent-based features
    # ASSERTION_START
    dir_in_stars = df[['Star1', 'Star2', 'Star3', 'Star4']].eq(df['Director'], axis=0).any(axis=1)
    assert (~dir_in_stars).all()
    def stars_all_distinct(row):
        vals = [row['Star1'], row['Star2'], row['Star3'], row['Star4']]
        return len(set(vals)) == 4
    assert df.apply(stars_all_distinct, axis=1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Compute ranking features
    rating_norm = df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0

    # Fill Meta_score for ranking only (assertions already checked bounds for non-nulls)
    meta_norm = (df['Meta_score'] / 100.0).fillna((df['Meta_score'] / 100.0).median())

    # Log-transform signals that require positivity
    votes_log = np.log(df['No_of_Votes'])
    votes_z = (votes_log - votes_log.mean()) / (votes_log.std() if votes_log.std() > 0 else 1.0)

    # Gross log-normalized; fill missing with median of available
    gross_log = np.log(pd.to_numeric(df['Gross_USD']))
    gross_log_filled = gross_log.fillna(gross_log.median())
    gl_min, gl_max = float(gross_log_filled.min()), float(gross_log_filled.max())
    gl_range = gl_max - gl_min if (gl_max - gl_min) != 0 else 1.0
    gross_norm = (gross_log_filled - gl_min) / gl_range

    # Runtime alignment (centered around ~120 min)
    runtime_alignment = 1.0 - np.minimum(1.0, np.abs(df['Runtime_Minutes'] - 120) / 120.0)

    # Aggregate weighted score
    df['weighted_score'] = (
        0.40 * rating_norm +
        0.15 * meta_norm +
        0.20 * votes_z +
        0.10 * gross_norm +
        0.10 * df['freshness_score'] +
        0.05 * runtime_alignment
    )

    # SEO fields
    df['seo_title'] = df['Series_Title'].astype(str) + ' (' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str) + ') | Stream Now'
    df['seo_description'] = (
        'Watch ' + df['Series_Title'].astype(str) + ' (' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str) + ') online. ' +
        'Rating: ' + df['IMDB_Rating'].round(1).astype(str) + '/10.'
    )
    df['is_family_friendly'] = (~horror_mask) & (~(cert_str == 'A'))

    # Rank for acquisition and SEO pages
    df = df.sort_values('weighted_score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    df['rank'] = np.arange(1, len(df) + 1)

    # Output enriched catalog
    enriched_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'slug', 'canonical_url', 'Poster_Link',
        'IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score', 'No_of_Votes', 'Gross_USD', 'Runtime_Minutes',
        'Genre', 'Certificate', 'weighted_score', 'rank', 'seo_title', 'seo_description'
    ]
    df[enriched_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'enriched_movies.csv'), index=False)

    # Top 100 list for SEO landing pages
    top_100 = df.head(100)[['Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'slug', 'canonical_url', 'Poster_Link', 'weighted_score', 'rank']]
    top_100.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'top_100_for_seo.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    # Functional dependency: for each (Series_Title, Released_Year) there is exactly one Poster_Link
    # ASSERTION_START
    pl_counts = df.groupby(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year'])['Poster_Link'].nunique(dropna=False)
    assert (pl_counts == 1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Runtime parsing depends on strict pattern
    # ASSERTION_START
    runtime_series = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
    assert runtime_series.str.fullmatch(r'^[0-9]{2,3} min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    runtime_extract = runtime_series.str.extract(r'^([0-9]{2,3}) min$')[0].astype(int)
    df['Runtime_Minutes'] = runtime_extract

    # Ranged runtime constraints used by runtime alignment
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['Runtime_Minutes'] >= 45) & (df['Runtime_Minutes'] <= 240)).all()
    pct_runtime_mid = ((df['Runtime_Minutes'] >= 80) & (df['Runtime_Minutes'] <= 180)).mean()
    assert pct_runtime_mid >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # IMDB rating bounds and distribution used in ranking
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 0.0) & (df['IMDB_Rating'] <= 10.0)).all()
    assert (df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Meta score sanity before correlation and weighting
    # ASSERTION_START
    non_null_meta = df['Meta_score'].notna()
    assert ((df.loc[non_null_meta, 'Meta_score'] >= 0) & (df.loc[non_null_meta, 'Meta_score'] <= 100)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Interplay of Meta_score and IMDB_Rating
    # ASSERTION_START
    meta_imdb = df[df['Meta_score'].notna()][['Meta_score', 'IMDB_Rating']]
    if len(meta_imdb) > 1:
        corr_val = meta_imdb['Meta_score'].corr(meta_imdb['IMDB_Rating'])
        assert corr_val > 0.4
    hi_meta = df[df['Meta_score'].notna() & (df['Meta_score'] >= 90)]
    if len(hi_meta) > 0:
        assert (hi_meta['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.5).mean() >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Certificate x Genre rules used to generate family-friendly flags
    # ASSERTION_START
    genre_str = df['Genre'].fillna('').astype(str)
    cert_str = df['Certificate'].fillna('').astype(str)
    horror_mask = genre_str.str.contains('Horror', case=False, regex=False)
    assert (~(horror_mask & cert_str.isin({'U', 'G'}))).all()
    anim_family_mask = genre_str.str.contains('Animation', case=False, regex=False) | genre_str.str.contains('Family', case=False, regex=False)
    assert (~(anim_family_mask & (cert_str == 'A'))).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Gross constraints before parsing and monetization features
    # ASSERTION_START
    gross_non_null = df['Gross'].notna()
    assert gross_non_null.mean() >= 0.80
    gross_str = df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross'].astype(str).str.strip()
    assert gross_str.str.fullmatch(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['Gross_USD'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross_USD'] = (
        df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross']
          .astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
          .astype(int)
    )

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df.loc[gross_non_null, 'Gross_USD'] > 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Votes constraints before log transform
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['No_of_Votes'] > 0).all()
    assert (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 10000).mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Director vs cast constraints before talent-based features
    # ASSERTION_START
    dir_in_stars = df[['Star1', 'Star2', 'Star3', 'Star4']].eq(df['Director'], axis=0).any(axis=1)
    assert (~dir_in_stars).all()
    def stars_all_distinct(row):
        vals = [row['Star1'], row['Star2'], row['Star3'], row['Star4']]
        return len(set(vals)) == 4
    assert df.apply(stars_all_distinct, axis=1).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Compute ranking features
    rating_norm = df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0

    # Fill Meta_score for ranking only (assertions already checked bounds for non-nulls)
    meta_norm = (df['Meta_score'] / 100.0).fillna((df['Meta_score'] / 100.0).median())

    # Log-transform signals that require positivity
    votes_log = np.log(df['No_of_Votes'])
    votes_z = (votes_log - votes_log.mean()) / (votes_log.std() if votes_log.std() > 0 else 1.0)

    # Gross log-normalized; fill missing with median of available
    gross_log = np.log(pd.to_numeric(df['Gross_USD']))
    gross_log_filled = gross_log.fillna(gross_log.median())
    gl_min, gl_max = float(gross_log_filled.min()), float(gross_log_filled.max())
    gl_range = gl_max - gl_min if (gl_max - gl_min) != 0 else 1.0
    gross_norm = (gross_log_filled - gl_min) / gl_range

    # Runtime alignment (centered around ~120 min)
    runtime_alignment = 1.0 - np.minimum(1.0, np.abs(df['Runtime_Minutes'] - 120) / 120.0)

    # Aggregate weighted score
    df['weighted_score'] = (
        0.40 * rating_norm +
        0.15 * meta_norm +
        0.20 * votes_z +
        0.10 * gross_norm +
        0.10 * df['freshness_score'] +
        0.05 * runtime_alignment
    )

    # SEO fields
    df['seo_title'] = df['Series_Title'].astype(str) + ' (' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str) + ') | Stream Now'
    df['seo_description'] = (
        'Watch ' + df['Series_Title'].astype(str) + ' (' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str) + ') online. ' +
        'Rating: ' + df['IMDB_Rating'].round(1).astype(str) + '/10.'
    )
    df['is_family_friendly'] = (~horror_mask) & (~(cert_str == 'A'))

    # Rank for acquisition and SEO pages
    df = df.sort_values('weighted_score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    df['rank'] = np.arange(1, len(df) + 1)

    # Output enriched catalog
    enriched_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'slug', 'canonical_url', 'Poster_Link',
        'IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score', 'No_of_Votes', 'Gross_USD', 'Runtime_Minutes',
        'Genre', 'Certificate', 'weighted_score', 'rank', 'seo_title', 'seo_description'
    ]
    df[enriched_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'enriched_movies.csv'), index=False)

    # Top 100 list for SEO landing pages
    top_100 = df.head(100)[['Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'slug', 'canonical_url', 'Poster_Link', 'weighted_score', 'rank']]
    top_100.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'top_100_for_seo.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
